description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeMembershipDecorator, which wraps an EmployeeMembership entity to provide additional methods for setting employee and membership references, formatting subscription dates, and retrieving the currency name associated with the membership.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeMembership entity providing helper methods for setting relations, formatting dates, and retrieving currency information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeMembershipDecorator with an EmployeeMembership instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Protected method to access the wrapped EmployeeMembership entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the membership based on employee number.

methods.name: setMembershipByMembershipId
methods.description: Sets the Membership associated with the employee membership based on membership ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted subscription commence date.

methods.name: getSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted subscription renewal date.

methods.name: getCurrencyName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the currency associated with the subscription, using an external PayGradeService.
